entities.summary: Katsiaryna Andrejeŭna Snytsina is a Kazakhstani-born Belarusian basketball player. She is 6ft 2in tall. She was part of the Belarusian teams that won a bronze medal at the 2007 European Championships and placed sixth at the 2008 Summer Olympics.
